اقترئن (form VIII)
# اُقْتُرِئْنَ (uqturiʔna) /uq.tu.riʔ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
# اِقْتَرِئْنَ (iqtariʔna) /iq.ta.riʔ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
